name: Book jacket Bookmarks
label: Hands-on workshop
address: 522 Second Street SE Suite D, Charlottesville, VA, 22902
description:
Turn a page and be reminded of your favorite book!
In this hands-on workshop, you'll transform the dust cover from a book you love into a beautiful, one-of-a-kind bookmark, giving something you love a whole new chapter in life.
Your instructor has developed a special process for finding and revealing the best parts of each jacket, as well as ensuring a sturdy, polished build. 
All materials are provided except for the book jacket. Bring it in, come ready to create, and turn it into a treasured keepsake.
Designed for adults and older teens. No previous experience necessary.
